name: Bible
about: Russian Synodal translation, daily readings by plan
help.what: The Bible (Russian Synodal translation, 66 books) and daily readings by the chosen plan.
help.1: Book and chapter — the button with the name at the top; arrows — neighbouring chapters.
help.2: At the end of a chapter — «Read»: the mark goes to the plan and the home screen.
help.3: The reading plan is chosen in Modules and features → Church mode.
help.tip: A missed day does not burn: readings wait, the rhythm is weekly.
